examples.arabic: أمي بتقولي إن اختيار الفستان زي اختيار رئيس الجمهورية صعب
examples.english: My mom tells me that choosing the dress is as difficult as choosing the President of the Republic.
examples.transliteration: Ommi betʾūli en ekhtiyār el-fostān zayy ekhtiyār raʾīs el-gomhūrīya ṣaʿb.

examples.arabic: بابا بيشرح إن الوضع صعب أوي و قديم.
examples.english: Dad explains that the situation is very difficult and old.
examples.transliteration: Baba biyishrah in el-wad saab awi wa adeem.
examples.storyTitle: War News on the Day of Eid

examples.arabic: في الشوط التاني اللعب بقى صعب بس اللعيبة كانوا بيجروا بسرعة
examples.english: In the second half, the game got difficult but the players were running quickly.
examples.transliteration: fe el showt el tany el le3b ba2a sa3b bas el le3eeba kano beyegrou besor3a
examples.storyTitle: The National Team Match with the Family

examples.arabic: الموضوع كان صعب شوية عشان دي اول مرة اعمل الطبق ده في بيتي
examples.english: It was a bit difficult because this is the first time I cook this dish in my house.
examples.transliteration: El mawdoo' kan sa'b shwaya 'ashan di awel marra a'mel el taba' da fi beiti.

examples.english: At first, it was a little difficult.
My mother said: This food is difficult.
